evidence.title: Claude DesignをClaude Codeから動かしてループエンジニアリングする

name: Claude DesignをClaude Codeから動かしてループエンジニアリングする
summary: Japanese write-up on driving Claude Design from Claude Code over MCP to loop UI mock revisions.
description: Case study on moving design change requests out of a browser chat and into a repo changes.md written in EARS notation, with per-screen structure, UI element lists and requirements. Claude Code then reads and writes the Claude Design project through DesignSync MCP tools, screenshots the locally rendered screens and re-fixes only the diffs, which the author reports cut token use by roughly 20-30%.
contains: workflow: changes.md with EARS statements per screen
Claude Design MCP tools: DesignSync, finalize_plan, write_files
loop: apply changes, render locally, screenshot the full page, compare with requirements
